g.text: bay_prioritization = [1, 2, 3, 4] (front = preferred for insert, back = preferred for retrieve) ratio = 0.75 empty trays = 3

g.text: eligible bays = 4 -> insert-ready wanted = min(ceil(0.75 x 4), 3) = 3, retrieve-ready wanted = 1
